# Statement of Work SP-2026-01: data migration (services only, no subscription)

Customer: Spruce Capital · Fixed fee: $80,000.00 · Estimated effort: 400 hours
Billing: 50% at kickoff (invoiced 2026-06-01), 50% on customer acceptance of the final
migration.
Work is performed in the customer's data warehouse; migrated datasets belong to the
customer as they are loaded. If the customer terminates for convenience it pays for work
performed to date at cost plus a reasonable margin.
